from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial figures from a Form 10-Q, capturing both total assets and total revenues."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="The total assets value as reported (e.g., in millions, thousands)")
    total_assets_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the total assets figure: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    total_assets_date: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which total assets are reported, in YYYY-MM format")
    total_revenues: float | None = Field(description="The total revenues/net sales value as reported (e.g., in millions, thousands)")
    total_revenues_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the total revenues figure: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    revenues_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the revenue figure covers (e.g., 'three months ended')")
    revenues_period_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the revenues period, in YYYY-MM format")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
